selected_consumer.boundary: currentAppHandoff() immediately after resolver.resolve(..., 'current_app') and before resolver.buildUrl(...) or any navigation assignment
selected_consumer.reason: This is the single narrowest existing runtime boundary that already receives the canonical current_app handoff and directly controls the already-authorized navigation.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Shared producer and authority helper; changing it would broaden Unit 2 beyond one consumer and risk affecting every route role.
Root bootstrap launches Route Guardian rather than consuming the Route Guardian-to-current_app handoff.
Destination-side runtime occurs after Route Guardian navigation and is too late to block an invalid handoff before navigation.
Loads at the destination boundary and does not own the pre-navigation Route Guardian consumer decision.

sequence: Route Guardian loads the canonical resolver.
currentAppHandoff loads the verified Current Map and resolves current_app.
consumeCurrentAppHandoff validates the complete Unit 1 lineage against the same loaded map.
resolver.buildUrl is reachable only after validation returns.
The existing navigation assignment remains unchanged and receives only the validated map-issued URL.

contract_validation.source_role_rule: The active document filename must equal Current Map route_guardian.path before source_role is accepted as route_guardian.
contract_validation.destination_rule: The raw resolver handoff role and path must exactly equal Current Map current_app.
contract_validation.lineage_rule: Type, map path, map version, route epoch, and destination path must match the same verified Current Map and canonical resolver constants.
contract_validation.failure_rule: Any mismatch throws before buildUrl and before navigation.

preservation.claim_ceiling: Passive source integration and deterministic consumer tests only. No isolated integrated-runtime proof, browser proof, real-app observation, or Pass 3 closure is claimed.
